easy-hp-on-hit.expected_behavior: A successful hit decreases the player's raw health.

easy-view-health.expected_behavior: The health bar represents the raw player health.

medium-item-effect.expected_behavior: Using an area item damages every eligible target.

medium-item-hit-range.expected_behavior: All targets inside the effect radius receive the effect.

hard-exp-conservation.expected_behavior: Raw experience and displayed experience remain consistent.

medium-upgrade-dialog-close.expected_behavior: A successful upgrade selection closes the blocking dialog.

easy-movement-input.expected_behavior: Player movement follows the requested input direction.

hard-monster-spawn-continuity.expected_behavior: Regular monster spawning continues until the level schedule ends.

easy-weapon-cooldown.expected_behavior: An active weapon attacks again after each cooldown period.

medium-contact-cooldown.expected_behavior: A melee monster respects its configured interval between contact hits.

medium-projectile-collision.expected_behavior: A projectile collision with an enemy applies damage and consumes the projectile.

control-medium-item.expected_behavior: Normal item and progression transitions remain valid.
